# commit whatever version bounds other packages declare (a breaking change waiting for its
# release tag reports the old major version). Move a pin deliberately; drop it once PyPI covers it.

# pyproject.toml name (floors name the next version release-please will cut, not yet on PyPI).
# After a sibling is released and on PyPI: delete its line here. When the sibling branch is
# merged first, replace the branch with the merge commit on main until the release lands.
